sentences.text:
This is an application seeking to quash Fir in Crime No.579/2023, registered with Police Station
Rana Pratap Nagar, Nagpur, for the offence punishable under Section 376 of the Indian Penal Code,
on account of merits as well as settlement.
3.  The victim is present before us, who is identified by her Advocate.
The victim has filed reply-cum-affidavit stating that the matter is amicably settled and she do not wish to prosecute Prity 2/2 56.apl46.2024 the case.
On our query, she also stated about settlement and her no objection.
4. Learned APP seeks time to file reply.
